title: Necromancer with Skull Staff
description: A skeletal necromancer with blue glowing eyes and curved horns stands centrally, wearing dark armor under a flowing red and black tattered robe. He holds a tall staff topped with a small skull in his left hand while raising his right hand to conjure a glowing blue magical orb, surrounded by ghostly blue spirits, broken chains, barbed wire, floating debris, and a shattered mirror against a dark aurora-filled sky.
prompt: A skeletal necromancer with glowing blue eyes and demonic curved horns stands in the center wearing ornate dark armor beneath a flowing red and black tattered robe. He holds a tall staff topped with a small skull and raises his other hand to summon a glowing cyan magical orb surrounded by arcane symbols. Ethereal blue ghosts swirl around him along with broken chains, barbed wire, shattered mirror fragments, and floating debris including a broken wooden structure and bottle, all set against a dramatic night sky with vibrant green purple and yellow aurora borealis.
